players.bio: Alby Kelly-Heald born 18th March 2005) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper in Australia's A-League Men for Wellington Phoenix FC.

Alex Arthur Rufer (born 12 June 1996) is a New Zealand professional footballer who captains and plays as a central midfielder for Wellington Phoenix in the A-League. Rufer started his career with YoungHeart Manawatu. In February 2013, Rufer joined Wairarapa United. In August 2013, ahead of the A-League season, Rufer signed a three-year contract with Wellington Phoenix.

Bill Poni Tuiloma (born 27 March 1995) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Charlotte FC in Major League Soccer. Tuiloma has represented New Zealand since 2013 and was the first New Zealander to play in the top division of French football.
Carlo Armiento (born 4 June 1999), is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Brisbane Roar.

Corban Dallas Piper (born 10 September 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Wellington Phoenix in the A-League Men. Personal life Piper grew up on the Whangaparāoa Peninsula, Auckland. He played youth football for Hibiscus Coast AFC.

David Michael Ball (born 14 December 1989) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Wellington Phoenix in the A-League. He began his career at Manchester City, but never made a first-team appearance despite being a star player in the club's Reserve and Academy teams.

Fergus Gillion (born 19 January 2005) is a New Zealand footballer who plays for Wellington Phoenix. Personal life Gillion is the younger brother of Auckland FC forward Liam Gillion. Club career Youth career Gillion played for Onehunga Sports and then Auckland United at youth level, before joining the Phoenix academy in 2022.
Fin Conchie (born 10 August 2003) is a New Zealand association footballer currently playing for the Wellington Phoenix in the A-League Men.

Gabriel Edward Sloane-Rodrigues (European Portuguese: ; born 3 July 2007) is a New Zealand footballer who currently plays as a forward for Wellington Phoenix. He is the former youngest player in Wellington Phoenix history, making his debut against Melbourne City on 9 March 2024 at the age of 16 years and 250 days.

Gabriel Sloane-Rodrigues (born 3 July 2007) is a New Zealand footballer who currently plays as a forward for Wellington Phoenix. He is the current youngest player in Wellington Phoenix history, making his debut against Melbourne City on 9 March 2024 at the age of 16 years and 250 days.
Giancarlo Italiano (born 31 January 1983) is an Australian association football manager who currently manages the Wellington Phoenix.

Hideki Ishige (石毛 秀樹, Ishige Hideki; pronounced ; born 21 September 1994) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a winger for A-League club Wellington Phoenix. Primarily known for his time at Shimizu S-Pulse, Ishige has over 250 league appearances in his career.

Ifeanyi Eze (Igbo: ; born 7 May 1999) is a Nigerian footballer who plays as a forward for A-League club Wellington Phoenix. Career Al-Karkh SC In the 2024–25 season, Eze scored 15 goals in 34 league appearances for Al-Karkh SC of the Iraq Stars League. Wellington Phoenix In July 2025, Eze signed for A-League Men club Wellington Phoenix on a 1-year contract.
Isaac Robert Hughes (born 25 March 2004) is an English-born, New Zealand footballer who plays for Wellington Phoenix.

Oluwaferanmi Joshua Chibuzo Oluwayemi (born 13 March 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Chelmsford City, on loan from EFL League One club Portsmouth. Club career Born in Waltham Forest, Oluwayemi joined Tottenham Hotspur's academy at the age of 10, subsequently coming through the club's youth ranks.

Kazuki Nagasawa (長澤 和輝 Nagasawa Kazuki, born 16 December 1991) is a Japanese footballer who plays as a midfielder for Urawa Red Diamonds. Nagasawa made his debut for Yokohama F. Marinos on 3 April 2013 in the J. League Cup against Omiya Ardija in which he came on in the 76th minute as Yokohama lost the match 1–0. On 23 December 2013 it was confirmed that Nagasawa had signed for German side 1.
Lukas Kelly-Heald (born 18 March 2005) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Wellington Phoenix.
Luke Supyk (born 4 March 2006) is a New Zealand footballer who currently plays as a forward for Wellington Phoenix.
Manjrekar James (born 5 August 1993) is a Canadian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Chornomorets Odesa on loan from Vejle Boldklub and the Canada national team.
Matthew Sheridan (born 9 May 2004) is a New Zealand footballer who plays for Wellington Phoenix.
Max Anderson (born 17 May 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Wellington Phoenix.

Mohamed Al-Taay (born 15 June 2000) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Wellington Phoenix. Having come through the Western Sydney Wanderers academy and NPL program, Al-Taay joined Newcastle Jets ahead of the 2021-22 season, in the hope of breaking through for his A-League debut.

Nathan Barry Walker (born 30 January 2006) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a winger for Wellington Phoenix in the A-League Men. Early life Walker was born in Auckland in 2006. His father is former New Zealand international cricketer Brooke Walker.

Nikola Mileusnic is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger or forward for the A-League Men club Wellington Phoenix. He previously played for Danish Superliga club Randers and A-League Men club Adelaide United. He is one of the fastest players in the world, having exceeded 36km/h in games.

Ramy Najjarine (born 23 April 2000) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Australian club Western United. On 30 June 2021, Najjarine returned to Western Sydney Wanderers, having already played for their academy. His first goal for the club came on 16 March 2022, helping his side beat Adelaide United 2–1 away from home.

Sarpreet Singh (born 20 February 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for A-League Men club Wellington Phoenix, on loan from Serbian SuperLiga club TSC and the New Zealand national team.

Tze-Xuan Loke (Chinese: 子轩, romanized: Zǐ Xuān, pronounced ; born 26 March 2005) is a professional footballer who plays for the Wellington Phoenix. Born in Singapore, he represents New Zealand at the youth level. Club career Youth career Born in Singapore, Loke moved to Dunedin with his parents at a young age.
